steps.title: Prepare U2OS cell culture
steps.instruction: Grow U2OS cells in DMEM supplemented with 10 % FBS, 2 mM L‑glutamine and 1 % penicillin‑streptomycin at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Passage cells twice weekly when they reach ~80 % confluency using 0.25 % trypsin/EDTA, and freeze aliquots at –150 °C in FBS containing 10 % DMSO. On the assay day, seed enough 10 cm dishes to reach 70‑80 % confluency (one dish supplies two 384‑well plates).

steps.title: Resuspend lyophilized siRNA (Stock1)
steps.instruction: Bring the 96‑well plates containing lyophilized siRNA (0.1 nmol per well) from –80 °C to the sterile bench and centrifuge briefly. Dispense 15 µl RNase‑free water into each well of a 96‑well v‑bottom plate (H₂O plate) with a multi‑channel pipette. Using the Selma pipetting robot, transfer 10 µl of this water into each siRNA well, yielding a 10 µM stock (Stock1 plate). Mix by pipetting up‑and‑down in “mixing cycles” mode. Cover the Stock1 plate with an aluminum seal and store at –80 °C or proceed directly.

steps.title: Count and dilute U2OS cells
steps.instruction: Wash each 10 cm dish with 2 ml sterile PBS, add 1.5 ml 0.25 % trypsin/EDTA and incubate ~5 min at room temperature until cells detach. Block trypsin by adding 8 ml DMEM (+10 % FBS, +2 mM L‑glutamine, no penicillin‑streptomycin). Pool all cells in a sterile 15 ml or 50 ml flask. Count cells with a Neubauer chamber and dilute in DMEM(–P/S) to a density of 7.14 × 10⁴ cells ml⁻¹ (1 500 cells in 21 µl).

steps.title: Create 1 µM siRNA working solution (Stock2)
steps.instruction: Dispense 15 µl RNase‑free water into each well of a new 96‑well v‑bottom plate (H₂O plate). Using the robot in “sample dilution” mode, pipette 9 µl water from the H₂O plate and then 1 µl from the Stock1 plate into the same tip and release into the new plate, producing a 1 µM siRNA solution (Stock2 plate). Mix by pipetting up‑and‑down (mixing cycles).

steps.title: Coat 384‑well plate with poly‑L‑lysine
steps.instruction: Transfer 30 µl poly‑L‑lysine into every well of a 384‑well imaging plate with a multi‑channel pipette. Incubate ≥1 h at room temperature, then remove the solution with a multi‑channel pipette and discard. Allow the plate to air‑dry for a few minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Lipofectamine‑RNAiMax mix
steps.instruction: Mix 3 382 µl Opti‑MEM with 38 µl Lipofectamine RNAiMax (final per‑well ratio 8.9 µl Opti‑MEM + 0.1 µl Lipofectamine). Place the mixture in a reservoir (Lipo‑Opti‑Mix). Transfer 50 µl of this mix into each well of a 96‑well v‑bottom plate (Lipo plate), avoiding the outer rim.

steps.title: Combine siRNA with Lipofectamine and dispense
steps.instruction: Equip the robot with fresh tips. For each well, aspirate 9 µl Lipo‑Opti‑Mix from the Lipo plate, then 0.9 µl siRNA from the Stock2 plate, and dispense the combined volume into the first replicate well (green) of the 384‑well imaging plate. Repeat the procedure three more times to generate quadruplicate wells for each siRNA, always avoiding the outer rim. Incubate the plate 20 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Seed cells into 384‑well plate
steps.instruction: Dispense 21 µl of DMEM(–P/S) containing 1 500 U2OS cells into each well (total 11.76 ml for a full plate) using a multi‑channel pipette. Ensure the liquid reaches the well bottom; centrifuge the plate at 161 × g with appropriate inlays if needed. Add 30 µl DMEM(–P/S) to each edge well (black wells) to minimise edge effects.

steps.title: Incubate transfected cells
steps.instruction: Place the 384‑well imaging plate in a humidified cell‑culture incubator at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ and incubate for 72 h.

steps.title: Fix cells with PFA
steps.instruction: Discard the culture medium. Add 50 µl 4 % paraformaldehyde in PBS to each well and incubate 15 min at room temperature. Discard PFA waste in sealed glass bottles according to EH&S guidelines.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS
steps.instruction: Wash each well three times with 100 µl self‑made PBS using a multi‑channel pipette. After each wash, remove PBS by turning the plate upside‑down over a sink. After the final wash, either store the plate with 100 µl PBS per well at 4 °C or proceed directly to permeabilisation.

steps.title: Permeabilize cells
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl 0.5 % Triton X‑100 in PBS to each well, incubate 10 min at room temperature, then discard the solution.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl 1 % BSA in PBS to each well, incubate 1 h at room temperature, then discard.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Prepare a primary‑antibody solution in 0.1 % BSA/PBS (choose one: anti‑ATG12 1:50, anti‑GABARAP 1:200, anti‑LC3B 1:800, anti‑STX17 1:250, or anti‑WIPI2 1:500). Dispense 20 µl per well, incubate 1 h at room temperature, then discard.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Prepare secondary‑antibody solution (Alexa Fluor 488 goat anti‑rabbit or anti‑mouse, 1:1 000) in 0.1 % BSA/PBS. Dispense 20 µl per well, incubate 1 h at room temperature, then discard.

steps.title: Cytoplasmic stain with CellMask
steps.instruction: Prepare CellMask Deep Red stain 1:25 000 000 in 0.1 % BSA/PBS. Dispense 20 µl per well, incubate 1 h at room temperature, then discard.

steps.title: Nuclear stain with DRAQ5
steps.instruction: Prepare DRAQ5 1:5 000 in 0.1 % BSA/PBS. Dispense 20 µl per well, incubate 10 min at room temperature, then discard.

steps.title: Final PBS rinse and seal
steps.instruction: Wash three times with 100 µl PBS using an automated dispenser. After the last wash, add 100 µl sterile PBS to each well, seal the plate with an aluminum seal, and store at 4 °C protected from light until image acquisition.

steps.title: Prepare PBS buffer
steps.instruction: Make phosphate‑buffered saline (pH 7.4) containing 137 mM NaCl, 2.7 mM KCl, 9 mM Na₂HPO₄ and 3 mM KH₂PO₄.
